parameters.query: WITH r AS (UPDATE injury SET status='resolved', resolved_on=current_date WHERE id=$3 AND bot_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND status<>'resolved' RETURNING id, area), d AS (UPDATE exclusion e SET active=false FROM r WHERE e.bot_id=$1 AND e.user_id=$2 AND e.source_type='injury' AND e.source_ref=r.id AND e.active RETURNING e.value) SELECT (SELECT area FROM r) AS resolved_area, (SELECT json_agg(value) FROM d) AS lifted;
